how: Built once on 2026-11-23 from RuleSet.baseline() of every release tag v1.0.0 to v1.20.0: the engine source of each tag (git archive TAG src/spellwarden_scan), imported on its own. Each id holds its title in the release it first shipped in; renamed lists each later change of a title alone, in release order. A rule added later gets its row in the commit that adds it, with the release it first ships in; a retired id moves to retired and keeps its row.
